scripts.build: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/discord-pdf-wrangler-logs wrangler deploy --config wrangler.gateway.jsonc --dry-run --outdir output/gateway && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/discord-pdf-wrangler-logs wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc --dry-run --outdir output/preview
scripts.types: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/discord-pdf-wrangler-logs wrangler types --config wrangler.gateway.jsonc src/gateway/env.d.ts --env-interface GatewayEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=/tmp/discord-pdf-wrangler-logs wrangler types --config wrangler.preview.jsonc src/preview/env.d.ts --env-interface PreviewEnv --include-runtime false
